items.title: 7th Aug 2026, Friday. National Day Celebrations and seating plan
items.author: Cai Yi Tian
items.description:
Hey Hwa Chong! 👋
Singapore turns 61 this year, and the Students' National Education Council (SNEC) is excited to invite you to our National Day Celebrations 2026: Majulah Singapura, Go Beyond! Join us as we celebrate our nation’s journey and the Singapore spirit that captures our aspirations to move forward, where we show concern for one another and for our wider community.
🗓 Date: Friday, 7th August 2026
🕗 Time: 0815hrs - 1030hrs
👔 Attire: Red ❤️ or white 🤍 top with HCI bottoms to show your Singapore spirit!
Please note that spaghetti-strap tops, midriff-baring tops, off-shoulder tops, low-cut tops, backless tops, tube tops, tops with cut-outs, and tops with inappropriate words or designs are NOT permitted.
Additionally, don’t miss out on our post-concert food redemption, featuring local favourites such as prata and satay! 😋Students will be required to complete at least 3 of the following activities in order to redeem their prizes:
Follow the SNEC Instagram account (Compulsory)
Complete a feedback form about the event (Compulsory)
Post an Instagram story of a photo taken at the decorated mirrors or any National Day decorations (like the SG61), and tag the SNEC Instagram account
Vote in the NE LJ showcase exhibition
Do refer to the attached programme schedule and seating plan for more details.
Follow @hcisnec on Instagram for more National Day sneak peaks 👀!
We look forward to seeing you on 7th August for a memorable National Day celebration! 🎉
Happy Birthday Singapore 🦁,
14th SNEC

items.title: [ECG] Ask Me Anything: Oxford Alumni Sharing Session @ HCI
items.author: Attarwala Khadija Sadiq Husain
items.description:
📢 Ask Me Anything: Oxford Alumni Sharing Session
Thinking about studying Law at Oxford or curious about university life in the UK? Join us for an exclusive Ask Me Anything (AMA) session with HCI alumnus Kaleb Teo (Class of 2024).
Kaleb is currently pursuing a Bachelor of Arts in Jurisprudence (Law) at Magdalen College, University of Oxford. During his time at Hwa Chong, he was part of the Humanities Programme in JC and the Chinese Language Elective Programme in High School. In 2025, he was awarded the President’s-cum-Public Service Commission (Legal/Judicial Service) Scholarship.
Come hear about his journey to Oxford, his experiences studying Law, scholarship applications, and student life. There will also be plenty of opportunities to ask your own questions!
📅 Date: 12 August
🕒 Time: 3.00 pm – 4.00 pm
📍 Venue: ECG LT, Block D, Level 3
🔗 Register
HERE
We look forward to seeing you there!
Kind Regards
Ms Khadija A
Senior ECG Counsellor
ECG Unit
